Manage document storage. Files not opened for 30+ days are automatically compressed to save space.

Document Storage
—
Total Files
—
Active

💤 Standby
ℹ️
How it works
📁 Files are stored in the remc_docs folder next to the app
💤 After 30 days without opening, files are automatically compressed (saves ~30-50% space)
👁 When you click Open on a standby file, it decompresses instantly
🗑 Deleting a document from a quotation also deletes the file from disk
✅ You can safely delete the original file from your PC after uploading

Download a copy of all your data, or restore it from a file you saved earlier.
⏱️
Automatic backup to a folder
Saves an Excel copy to a folder on this computer, on a schedule — no clicking needed
How often
Save folder (required)
No folder chosen
Works in Chrome and Edge. The file is an Excel workbook with a separate sheet for every part of the system: Projects, Quotations, Bookings, Employees, Departments, Supervisors, Materials, Sub-contractors, Team Planning, Office Access, Notes and Machines. Automatic backups run while this app stays open; after a browser restart, click Back up now once to reconnect the folder.
1
Download a backup
Saves everything (projects, bookings, notes, supervisors) to your computer
You get an Excel file you can open, plus a data file used to restore.
2
Restore from a backup
Loads a backup file back into the system
⚠ Restoring replaces the current data on this device and syncs it to everyone.
